shortDescription: UPESSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 notification released for 1936 vacancies. Online applications are open from 08 September 2026 to 07 October 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has released the Assistant Professor Advt No 04/2026 notification for recruitment of 1936 posts.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply online from 08 September 2026 to 07 October 2026. Before applying, candidates should read the official information brochure and subject-wise eligibility details carefully.

Important Dates

  • Application begin: 08/09/2026
  • Last date for registration: 07/10/2026
  • Last date fee payment: 07/10/2026
  • Last date correction: 11/10/2026
  • Assistant Professor exam date: 19-20 November 2026
  • Admit card: Before exam
  • Result: As per schedule

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: ₹2000
  • SC / ST: ₹1500
  • PH (Divyang): ₹1000

Fee can be paid through debit card, credit card, net banking or UPI.

Age Limit

Maximum age limit is 62 years as on 01/07/2026. Age relaxation is available as per the UPESSC rules.

Vacancy Details

Total vacancies: 1936 posts. The post is for Assistant Professor in various subjects and colleges across Uttar Pradesh.

Eligibility

  • Master degree in the relevant subject with minimum 55% marks
  • NET / SET / SLET / PhD as applicable
  • Subject-wise eligibility details are given in the official notification

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official UPESSC website or portal.
  2. Complete the One Time Registration (OTR).
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational and contact details.
  4. Upload required documents.
  5. Pay the exam fee.
  6. Review the final form and submit it.
  7. Save the confirmation page and print the application form.

Read the full notification before applying and keep all required documents ready.

Official Website: UPESSC
